checks.text: The page heading is "Word Counter" and the initial stats panel shows "Words: 0", "Characters: 0", "Sentences: 0", "Paragraphs: 0", and "Reading time: 0 min".
Typing "Hello world. This is a test." into the editor updates the stats to "Words: 6", "Characters: 28", "Sentences: 2", "Paragraphs: 1", and "Reading time: 0 min".

Clearing the editor and typing "One two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven twelve thirteen fourteen fifteen sixteen seventeen eighteen nineteen twenty." updates the stats to "Words: 20", "Characters: 132", "Sentences: 1", "Paragraphs: 1", and "Reading time: 0 min".

With the text "First paragraph.", a blank line, then "Second paragraph." in the editor, clicking the tab labelled "Report" shows a table with rows "Words: 4", "Characters: 35", "Sentences: 2", "Paragraphs: 2", and "Reading time: 0 min".
With the text "Hello world." in the editor, clicking the button "Copy text" places "Hello world." on the clipboard and shows a toast "Copied".
With the text "Hello world." in the editor, clicking the button "Download report" triggers a file download named "word-counter-report.txt" containing the line "Words: 2".
With the text "Hello world." in the editor, toggling the switch labelled "Count punctuation" to off changes the "Characters" stat from "12" to "11".
With the text "Hello world." in the editor, clicking the button "Clear" empties the editor and resets all stats to zero.
Reload keeps the text "Hello world." in the editor and the stat "Words: 2".
